questions.enonce_markdown: Find, to 1 decimal place, the length of an arc $PQ$ which subtends an angle of $60^\circ$ at the centre of a circle with radius $5.6\,\mathrm{cm}$, taking $\pi = \dfrac{22}{7}$. *[4 marks]*
